reviews.title: Dante keeps me playing
reviews.text: I really like the designs of this game (ESPECIALLY Dante) but! It’s really really money hungry. I came back to this game after a while and don’t remember it being so hungry so it definitely made the game harder to play for fun. On top of that, there isn’t much to do. If you don’t have a strong enough team for battle nor money to pull for stronger characters, you’re just stuck to maybe hope to get more rewards from mail or friends codes (which are only used one time for any actual rewards) I will keep playing for my beautiful man Dante but otherwise, 3 stars. 😖
